title: Collect phone number at sign-in, remove ✅ emoji from Confirm Booking button, fix Book Online redirect, show all user data in admin panel

requirements.text: When a user signs in via Internet Identity for the first time, collect their phone number as part of the profile setup modal (in addition to name and service area already collected in ProfileModal). Store the phone number in the backend user profile.

quotes: sign karte time user ka phone number bhi le Lena

acceptanceCriteria: ProfileModal includes a required phone number input field
Phone number is submitted and saved to the backend user profile via registerUser
Admin panel displays the stored phone number for each user
Phone number field is validated (numeric, reasonable length)

requirements.text: Remove the ✅ emoji from the 'Confirm Booking' button label in the booking form. The button text should read 'Confirm Booking' without any emoji.

quotes: Jo tumne confirm booking ke button pe ye wala emoji diya hai ise hata do ye wala ✅

acceptanceCriteria: The Confirm Booking button contains no ✅ emoji anywhere in its label or children

requirements.text: Fix the 'Book Online' button on each ServiceCard so that clicking it navigates the user to a dedicated booking page (e.g. /booking). Create a BookingPage component if it does not already exist, containing the full booking form. Wire the ServiceCard button to route to this page.

quotes: Service card पर Book Online button — इसे click करने पर एक अलग booking page पर redirect होगा

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Book Online' on any ServiceCard navigates to a /booking route
The /booking route renders a full booking form
The booking form is functional and submits correctly
Navigation back to the main page is available from the booking page

requirements.text: Update the Admin panel to display a comprehensive list of all registered users with their full profile data: name, phone number, principal ID, service area, and sign-in/registration time. Also display all submitted bookings linked to each user where available.

quotes: Admin panel में sign-in किए हुए सभी users का पूरा data दिखेगा

acceptanceCriteria: Admin panel Users tab shows name, phone number, principal ID, service area, and registration timestamp for every registered user
All user records fetched from backend are displayed in a table or card list
Backend admin query returns phone number as part of user profile data
Admin panel is only accessible to the designated admin principal

constraints: Do not modify files listed in frontend.immutablePaths
All Motoko logic must remain in the single backend/main.mo actor
Preserve existing FormSubmit-based booking form submission mechanism unless replacing with a backend-stored booking
